subject: Concurrency uplift & blended discount proposal
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily@luminaworks.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@procureops.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: initial quota conversation

Hi Karthik —

We reviewed the usage export you sent and we're seeing repeated concurrency throttles during peak windows (08:00–10:30 PT). Our engineering team needs a provisional uplift to avoid queue pileup for a two-week launch. Can you confirm: 

- What incremental concurrency (qps) you can provision quickly?
- Whether Redwood will apply a one-time grace credit for the overrun during the onboarding burst?
- Contact for PO and scope of billing adjustments if this becomes permanent?

I've attached the May usage summary. Procurement is copied to make sure we capture PO timing. Appreciate a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Emily
Head of Platform Engineering, LuminaWorks
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@luminaworks.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, ProcureOps <procure@procureops.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concurrency uplift & blended discount proposal

Emily — thanks for the usage file and the clear ask. Quick answers up front:

- Short-term uplift: we can provision a provisional +60% concurrency window for the next 14 days (same region) within 4 hours of approval.
- Grace credit: Redwood is open to a one-time partial credit that scales with overrun tokens; proposed approach below.
- PO & billing: Laura (cc) handles procurement; we can accept an expedited PO (net-15) referencing deal LUM-2027-42.

Proposed blended path (summary):
1) Two-week provisional uplift (14 days) at +60% concurrency, immediate activation upon PO or an authorized email.
2) During the provisional window, we will calculate the overrun delta vs. committed monthly baseline and apply a 50% credit on incremental token/throughput charges up to a capped amount ($12k).
3) If usage stabilizes above baseline and you want a permanent increase, we convert to a stepped-commit with volume discounts (3-tier: baseline, mid, high) and a 6-week notice to scale.

Next steps I suggest: 1) Laura will circulate a short SOW amendment + provisional rate sheet; 2) Emily signs approval email or PO; 3) activation and telemetry checks on first day.

I'm on call 1–3 PM PT if you want to hop on.

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@luminaworks.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, ProcureOps <procure@procureops.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concurrency uplift & blended discount proposal

Emily — following Karthik's note, attaching the provisional-rate-sheet.pdf and the short amendment template for quick signature. A few clarifications on the credit mechanics so procurement can review: 

- Credit calculation: at the end of the provisional window we'll compute total incremental tokens/compute above your committed baseline for the month and apply a 50% credit up to $12,000. Any excess over the cap will be billed at the provisional uplift rate.
- Auditability: we'll include token-level breakdown and a CSV export for reconciliation (we'll send the May export plus daily deltas).
- PO reference: include deal ID LUM-2027-42 and the amendment number (AMND-07).

If you confirm PO or send an approval email with the amendment language, we can turn the uplift on within the 4-hour SLA. Markus — if Procurement requests a graded discount extension beyond the $12k cap, what's our internal approval path?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Emily Zhao <emily@luminaworks.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@procureops.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concurrency uplift & blended discount proposal

Laura / Karthik / Emily — quick internal note and concession path: 

If LuminaWorks signs the provisional amendment within 48 hours and provides a PO for the uplift, I can approve increasing the grace credit cap from $12k to $20k as a one-time concession. Conditions:
- PO references LUM-2027-42 and AMND-07.
- Usage telemetry confirms the peak windows are consistent with the attached CSV deltas.
- Contract amendment for a stepped-commit conversion (if they move to a permanent increase) must be executed within 90 days or concession is one-time only.

Emily — happy to jump on a 20-min call if you'd like to walk through the numbers with procurement. If you can send an approval email or PO by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-11), we will schedule activation immediately after PO ingestion.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
